subject: Quarterly commit stewardship — open save-plan asks and owners
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-07-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quarterly commit stewardship — open save-plan asks and owners

Team,

We need a concise save plan for RE-3241 (Acme) ahead of tomorrow's forecast review. ACME's procurement pause pushed this deal to yellow and the finance team wants a clear set of owner actions if we don't get legal/PO by 7/16.

Please own the bullets below and drop updates in the sheet (attached) by EOD tomorrow: 
- Marissa: confirm demo follow-up deliverable (ETA + evidence) and whether product exec will re-engage; note any feature asks that could delay PO (owner: Marissa).
- Vivek: pricing concession window — can we hold list price through 7/23 if we drop a term? Need opinion + fallback (owner: Vivek).
- Monica: procurement questionnaire status & missing SOC evidence (owner: Monica).

Attached: RE-3241_save-plan-v1.pdf and commit matrix. Keep responses short — I’ll synthesize into the save-plan to present at the review.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
From: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@acme.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-07-09T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly commit stewardship — open save-plan asks and owners

Avery — thanks for the clear asks. Quick replies from our side: 
- Procurement is missing SOC 2 attestation and a short data-retention statement. I copied procurement to this thread.
- Legal expects a standard SOW and PO; commercial has pushed to reconcile a single-term concession around data residency (we flagged for legal).

We'll try to get provisional PO language by 7/14 but can't promise full signed PO until legal and procurement alignment. Sara

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-10T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly commit stewardship — open save-plan asks and owners

Quick update from pricing: we can hold list price through 7/23 for this deal provided we tie the concession to a 12-month committed volume and accept a 30% non-refundable initial payment. That's our recommended fallback — protects ARR while giving Acme runway.

Action items I kicked off: 
- Draft concession language (attached to this reply in the matrix).
- Ask legal to pre-approve template clause (Marissa — can you ping legal contact?).

I also added a column in the commit-matrix (attached) for 'concession impact' and expected ARR delta.

Vivek
Head of Sales Operations
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@acme.com>, acme-procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-07-12T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly commit stewardship — open save-plan asks and owners

Thanks everyone — short synthesis for the forecast review: 
- Status: DEAL -> Yellow (procurement legal gap).
- Owners & asks: Marissa to confirm product exec availability for a short executive demo by 7/13; Monica to upload SOC 2 evidence and retention statement by 7/14; Vivek to send concession clause and confirmed payment term (as noted).
- External note: Sara indicated provisional PO language possible by 7/14 but full signed PO likely later.

I updated the Google sheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF-RE3241 and attached the current save-plan (RE-3241_save-plan-v1.pdf). If any of you become unavailable, please escalate to the regional SDR.

I'll present this at the forecast review tomorrow; if anything changes before then reply-all with the short bullet.

Avery
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachments: RE-3241_save-plan-v1.pdf, RE-3241-commit-matrix.xlsx
